Method of Attack: Exploitation of a flaw allowing attackers to escalate from XSS to remote code execution (RCE) by manipulating the nodeIntegration option via a WebView component in Electron apps.
Impacted Systems: Electron-based desktop applications including Microsoft's Skype, Visual Studio Code, GitHub's Atom, Brave browser, Twitch, Discord, Basecamp, Slack, Ghost, WordPress.com
Attack Vector: Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability inside Electron apps to create a WebView component with nodeIntegration set to true
